roof.method: Anterior complete triangles retained. At D>=54 rear grid cells are fit to the safe boundary and each resulting polygon is triangulated; only complete contained triangles are inset by half the web and corner-rounded. Clipped polygons are never aperture profiles.

base.method: Anterior complete triangles retained. At D>=54 rear grid cells are fit to the safe boundary and each resulting polygon is triangulated; only complete contained triangles are inset by half the web and corner-rounded. Clipped polygons are never aperture profiles.
base.bottom_overlap: Plate starts 0.1 mm above the shell floor and its outline is inset 0.25 mm, creating volumetric skirt overlap instead of coincident bottom/side edges.
base.note: New base; no frozen V0.6 lower geometry. Contact feet and optical/service positions retained; planar load paths deliberately rebuilt.

verification_scope: Mother-surface/front-contour smoke snapshot before final relief and vent revisions. Roof/base subrecords are historical; current cutter profiles are vent_layout.json and saved-artifact evidence is design_checks.json.
